text:
Lena (Sales): quick handoff — SparrowClinic just signed MSA. They're a mid-market healthcare customer. Primary asks: Private deployment in our VPC with VPC peering to their network, SAML SSO (IdP: Okta), HSM-backed KMS for keys, and a dedicated GPU pool for embeddings + chat. Start config: embeddings on 1xA100, chat on 2xA10. Go-live target 6 weeks. Renewal in 10 months; budget constraints flagged by procurement (renewal-risk: high). Main contacts: renee@sparrowclinic and aj@ (platform). Passing to CS & infra for onboarding and security review.

Diego (CS): thanks, adding to my queue. quick clarifiers: is the BA signed (HIPAA BAA)? Where will logs land (do they want us to disable certain logs)? expected token/month so support/cost can plan?

Lena (Sales): BA signed this morning. Logs: they want event logs minimal; no raw clinical text stored in analytics DB — only hashed IDs. Tokens: estimate ~30M tokens/month initially, ramp to ~120M in 3 months. Will share the usage forecast sheet offline.

Priya (Eng): ok. I'll open infra ticket for Private deploy + HSM/KMS and include VPC peering checklist. Need their allowlist CIDRs, latency SLOs, and whether they require egress restrictions. Also: do they expect synchronous embeddings on request or batched nightly?

Lena (Sales): embeddings: nightly batch for indexing + on-demand for a subset of requests. They'd like embedding latency <1s for on-demand.

Sam (Support): I'll craft a high-priority support plan and an incident runbook tailored for PHI-sensitive customers. Need expected qps/peak windows and contact escalation list. Also recommend adding a 24/7 pager for first 30 days post-go-live.

Nina (Enablement): I'll build a two-part enablement: (1) admin setup + SAML walkthrough, (2) end-user best-practices + prompt examples. Prefer to record and provide a short ops cheat-sheet. Requesting user roles and a staging user list.

Diego (CS): proposed owners: Diego = onboarding lead, Priya = infra lead, Sam = support lead, Nina = enablement lead. I'm scheduling a kickoff this week.

Priya (Eng): creating INF-5009 now with eng-cloud & eng-runtime. Will include: GPU sizing, network diagram, KMS/HSM options, quantization strategy for embeddings, and an option to split embedding workload to dedicated nodes.

DeployBot: ticket INF-5009 created by Priya for SparrowClinic private deployment request.

Sam (Support): drafting runbook. Initial alert thresholds: 95th latency > 600ms for chat, embedding queue backlog > 50 jobs, error rate > 1% sustained for 5m. Will propose SLAs in doc.

Diego (CS): Action list (owner in parens):
- Create CS onboarding workspace + invite customer contacts (Diego)
- Kickoff call + confirm SAML metadata and allowlist CIDRs (Diego/Lena)
- Open infra ticket for Private + HSM (Priya)
- Draft support runbook & 30d pager rota (Sam)
- Enablement session + recordings (Nina)
- Share usage forecast and procurement constraints (Lena)

Nina (Enablement): will prepare a short eval prompt set to capture relevance and hallucination checks post-rollout. also include a short admin checklist for rotating keys.

Priya (Eng): note to infra: sample SAML config we typically send to customers: 
```
AssertionConsumerService: https://console.redwood.ai/saml/acs
EntityID: urn:redwood:saml:sp
NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
```
Send back metadata xml from their IdP and we'll validate.

Lena (Sales): I'll email renee & aj with the kickoff Doodle and copy Diego. also flag procurement constraints and request a payment cadence clarification.

Sam (Support): once infra tickets show provisioned nodes I'll run a smoke test with eng and record metrics. planning a simulated failover to validate runbook.

Diego (CS): tentative timeline: week0 kickoff + SAML exchange, week1 infra provisioning + peering test, week2 enablement + integration, week3 pilot with limited users, week5 expand, week6 go-live. I'll track renewal notes in the customer health dashboard and set a 6mo review with finance.

Lena (Sales): thanks all. tagging owners @Priya @Sam @Nina @Diego. :raised_hands:

Diego (CS): I'll post the kickoff notes and invite link here after Doodle completes. updates will be short pings in this thread.

Lena (Sales): added procurement thread link and forecast spreadsheet to the customer record. :white_check_mark:
